scope: A fresh browser-rendered observation of the official Qavanin TreeText page for the 1372 amendment to the cheque law. The page rendered the title, approval date and eight-article text. This is not a raw-response capture, not an Official Gazette file, not the consolidated current law, and not an event-date legal version.

source.title: قانون اصلاح موادی از قانون صدور چک مصوب تیرماه ۱۳۵۵
source.closingTextObservation: The rendered page states that the law contains eight articles and five clauses and was approved by the Guardian Council on 1372/08/19.

limitations: Only the browser-rendered Qavanin HTML view was observed; raw HTTP response bytes were not captured.
No reproducible SHA-256 of the exact official text bytes is available.
The separate Attribute metadata page could not be retrieved in this recheck.
Official Gazette issue 14189 and its original file were not retrieved or hashed; no Gazette number is promoted from secondary sources.
This 1372 amendment alone does not establish the consolidated law or the version applicable to any particular cheque/event date.
No independent human legal review is recorded.
